objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All five pull_request/push and non-path workflows received a deliberate decision, and the required unit-tests check was correctly handled with always-run + early-skip semantics rather than a workflow-level path filter that would strand the required status.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: The listed paths largely map to what each workflow consumes (docs/mkdocs, src/deploy.sh, src/test), but every workflow that runs npm ci omits package-lock.json, so a lockfile-only dependency change would skip tests and deploy that actually depend on it.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The schedule-only and issue-driven workflows and the branch-protection ruleset were correctly left untouched, but the agent expanded scope beyond the audit by creating a new AGENTS.md doc and adding a workflow_dispatch trigger to tests.yml that weren't called for.
